grammar_focus: 一般将来时(主考:will+动词原形 · 'll缩略 · 各人称 · will be · 否定won't · 疑问Will…? · shall 仅 Shall we/Shall I 提议 · 过去转将来改写)+ be going to(辅考讲深)+ 一般现在·现在进行表将来(辅考讲深)
scene: 邻居船长明天启航 · 独自驾小帆船横渡大洋参加比赛 · 大家去码头送行、道别、加油

grammar_card.title: 说"将来要做什么"(一般将来时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"将来要发生、将来要做的事"——一般将来时。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 一般将来时 = will + 动词原形(表示'将要…')
Captain Reed will sail tomorrow.(明天将起航)
shall 在美语里只剩 Shall we…?/Shall I…? 提议这一用;表将来一律用 will(I shall 是英式/正式,美语不说)
Shall we go now?(要不要现在走?)
口语里 will 常缩略为 'll(I'll / he'll / we'll / they'll)
We'll say goodbye to him.(我们会跟他道别)
将来的状态 / 位置用 will be
He will be away for two months.(他将离开两个月)
否定:won't(will not);疑问:把 will 提前(Will he…?)
She won't be late. / Will he leave tomorrow?

specialRules.rule: be going to + 动词原形:表示计划好、打算要做的事,或有迹象很可能发生
时刻表用一般现在时、已安排好的事用现在进行时,也能表将来(The train leaves at 8 / We are having a party Friday)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Where is Captain Reed going, and how?
options: Across the ocean, on his little sailboat

passage: Our neighbor, Captain David Reed, will sail from the harbor tomorrow morning. We are going to meet him at the dock bright and early. He will be on his little sailboat, the Seabird. The Seabird is a famous little boat, and it has crossed the Atlantic many times. Captain Reed will set out at eight o'clock sharp, so we'll have plenty of time. We'll watch his boat leave, and then we'll say goodbye to him. "Good luck!" we will all shout from the dock. He is going to be away for about two months. We are all very proud of him. He will take part in an important race across the ocean. I think he will win, and we will welcome him home like a hero.

grammar_points.name: 一般将来时——构成 will + 动词原形
一般将来时——'ll 缩略 + 各人称
一般将来时——will be(将来的状态/位置)
一般将来时——否定 won't / 疑问 Will…?
一般将来时——过去，将来 改写辨识
be going to(计划打算 / 迹象)——辅考讲深
一般现在/现在进行 表将来(timetable/arranged)——辅考讲深
shall——仅 Shall we…?/Shall I…? 礼貌提议(美语将来用 will)
